bibliographic-data.invention-title: MÉTHODE DE FABRICATION DE COMPOSITIONS DE FIBRES DE SILICE
METHOD OF MAKING SILICA FIBER COMPOSITIONS

nplcit.text: - CHOI, SUNG-SEEN et al., "Silica nanofibers from electrospinning/sol-gel process", Journal of Materials Science Letters, (20030000), vol. 22, doi:10.1023/A:1024475022937, pages 891 - 893, XP001166787

abstract.p: Embodiments of the invention include silica fiber compositions useful for treatment of animal wounds and tissue, as well as for other applications in industry. The fiber compositions may be formed via electrospinning of a sol gel produced with a silicon alkoxide reagent, such as tetraethyl ortho silicate, alcohol solvent, and an acid catalyst.
